mentions.name: ThaiCoPilot
mentions.description: A Thai language learning application that walks learners through the language with a how-it-works video demo and sign-up access. The current focus is on getting the approach right for Thai before scaling the repeatable efforts to other languages.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a Thai language learning application(https://thaicopilot.com/) for months now, so I would love to get some feedback from the community. I plan to expand to other languages, but the thought process for now is to get it right for one language and scale up the repeatable efforts for all the others.
